oracle.description: Published 17-case output of the pinned upstream NRLMSISE-00 DOCUMENTATION file (release 20190709).
oracle.note: No expected value from this distribution is reproduced in the repository. Only derived ratios and reconstruction errors are recorded here.

tolerance.maximum_relative_rounding_derivation: relative ulp is 1e-6/m, so the half-ulp bound is 5e-7 at m=1 and falls below 1e-7 once m reaches 9
tolerance.drag_mass_propagation: the drag mass is a positive weighted sum of the constituents, so it inherits the same 5e-7 bound and cannot amplify it
tolerance.tolerance_justification: 1e-6 clears both the 5e-7 worst-case publication rounding and the 3.04e-7 actually observed. The margin is deliberately small: the oracle is published only to seven significant digits, so a looser tolerance would validate nothing while a tighter one would be measuring the printer instead of the model. Exact-equality assertions (1e-12 or bitwise) are used only for identities that must be exact, never for the published fixture.

oracle_integrity_check.statement: Recomputing the gtd7 mass from the published constituent columns reproduces the printed RHO column to a maximum 3.04e-7 relative error across all 17 cases. That figure is consistent with the 5e-7 worst-case half-ulp rounding of seven-significant-digit %E output and confirms both that the oracle is the published reference output rather than a re-run of this project's own wrapper, and the scale of the publication-rounding error entering the gtd7d expectation.
oracle_integrity_check.consequence: Confirms the oracle is the published reference output rather than a re-run of this project's own wrapper, and bounds the publication-rounding error entering the gtd7d expectation.

gtd7d_versus_gtd7_sensitivity.statement: Ratio of the drag-effective gtd7d mass to the gtd7 mass, derived from the published constituent columns.
gtd7d_versus_gtd7_sensitivity.significance: At and above the upper LEO the anomalous-oxygen term dominates the mass budget, so a backend reporting gtd7 rather than gtd7d understates drag density by more than twenty percent at 1000 km. This is the justification for the gtd7d choice.

execution_status: Tests are specified and registered but were not executed by this component; builds and test runs are performed once by the parent after full integration. No pass or fail claim is made in this file.
known_limitations: The oracle file is not redistributed; fixture tests SKIP when it is absent rather than passing.
Concurrent evaluation is safe but serialised by a process-wide mutex.
The 1000 km altitude ceiling is a project support limit, not a published validity boundary.
Geodetic/geocentric, ellipsoidal/spherical and UTC reduction happen upstream of this backend.

extraction_tool.purpose: regenerate the fixed-coefficient inventory (nested shape, explicit versus implied-zero initialiser counts, line spans, block SHA-256) from the pinned source without reproducing any coefficient value
extraction_tool.exit_status: 0 when the source matches the pinned SHA-256, 1 otherwise
